changelog:
Initial release of knuspr-cli skill.

- Enables grocery shopping management on Knuspr.de via bundled Python CLI.
- Supports product search, cart management, delivery slot reservation, shopping lists, order history, deals, favorites, and meal suggestions.
- Includes clear safety rules: no automatic purchases, always confirm destructive actions, and show prices before cart changes.
- Provides core usage examples and workflows for all major features.
- Full command reference available in the documentation.
summary: Manage grocery shopping on Knuspr.de via the knuspr-cli. Use for product search, cart management, delivery slot reservation, shopping lists, order history, deals, favorites, and meal suggestions. Trigger when the user mentions Knuspr, groceries, Einkauf, Lebensmittel, Warenkorb, Lieferslot, or shopping list tasks.
